throughline.headline: The Throughline
throughline.body: Every month, one story tends to explain most of what happened everywhere else. This month, that story was the Fed's decisive turn toward rate cuts — and almost everything below, from currencies to commodities to Indian flows, traces back to it.

currency.commentary: The dollar index slid through the month as rate-cut expectations got pulled forward, and the rupee firmed modestly against it despite India's own steady policy stance.

forex_story.headline: India's Forex Reserve
forex_story.body: Reserves rebuilt through most of the month before a late reversal, as the RBI sold dollars to defend the rupee against a stronger crude bill and steady foreign selling in equities.

commodities.commentary: Gold pushed to new highs as real yields fell. Silver followed with even sharper percentage gains, as it typically does in risk-on, rate-cut environments.

indian_indices.commentary: Nifty and Sensex both extended gains through the month, though almost the entire move came in the final week as easing global yields drew foreign flows back into risk assets.

flows_weekly.commentary: FII flows turned net positive for the first month in a while, tracking dollar weakness and the broader EM risk-on mood. DIIs stayed steady buyers throughout.

india.headline: GST Collections at Rs. 1.98 Lakh Crore
india.desc: Revenue rose amid steady festive-season imports.

india.headline: CPI Inflation Eases to 3.9%
india.desc: Softer food prices brought inflation below the RBI's midpoint.

india.headline: IIP Growth Hits 6.8%
india.desc: Manufacturing and electricity output led the improvement.

global.headline: Fed Signals Further Cuts
global.desc: Minutes showed growing consensus for a September move.

global.headline: Dollar Index Slips to 3-Month Low
global.desc: Broad-based rate-cut repricing weighed on the greenback.

global.headline: US Core PCE Softens
global.desc: The Fed's preferred inflation gauge cooled for a second month.
